mapper.select: SELECT c.name AS columnName, CAST(ISNULL(ep.value, c.name) AS NVARCHAR(MAX)) AS columnComment FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON t.object_id = c.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON c.user_type_id = ty.user_type_id LEFT JOIN sys.extended_properties ep ON ep.major_id = t.object_id AND ep.minor_id = c.column_id AND ep.name = 'MS_Description' WHERE t.name = #{tableName} ORDER BY c.column_id;
